Sources & coverage

News comes from Decrypt and Cointelegraph public RSS feeds through RSS2JSON, which returns up to 10 items per feed without a key. Headlines with at least two shared distinctive words are grouped into candidate stories. Ranking uses publisher count, article count and recency. This is lightweight headline clustering, not semantic analysis or an X trend detector. One publisher is LC0; multiple publishers are an LC1 candidate. Higher lifecycle stages and independent-account velocity are not inferred.

GeckoTerminal returns a sample of trending pools for Solana and Base. Major quote assets are excluded. Each token uses the most liquid returned pool, with pool-level buyers, volume and liquidity; these are not token-wide totals. Market cap stays blank when the provider does not supply it; FDV is shown separately in details. Pool creation is not token launch. Contracts come from the pool's base-token relationship, not ticker matching. Listing is not an authenticity or safety endorsement.

Crossovers require an exact CA in news evidence. A match does not prove narrative-first or coin-first origin. Group filters apply newsroom themes to news and chain filters to coins; unmatched coins remain unclassified. Axiom links simply open its token shortcut in a new tab; an Axiom session may be required. No wallet or trade is initiated.

Feeds refresh every five minutes while this page is visible. Failures are shown explicitly; there is no example-data fallback. News observations and complete ranking snapshots are saved only in this browser. Refreshing cannot reconstruct unseen history. X-watchlist collection, holder growth, semantic clustering and verified lifecycle transitions still need additional data services.
